title: 自遣
author: 罗隐
intro: A poet who failed the exams again and again tells himself to stop worrying: “If there’s wine today, get drunk today; if trouble comes tomorrow, worry tomorrow.” The third line became an everyday saying.
analysis: “自遣”就是自己安慰自己、排解心里的烦恼。诗人罗隐考了十次科举都没考上，这首诗像是他对自己说的话。第一句：得到了就放声高歌，失去了就算了，不要放在心上。第二句：愁也好，恨也好，都让它慢慢过去吧。后两句最有名：“今朝有酒今朝醉，明日愁来明日愁”——今天有酒，今天就喝个痛快；明天的烦恼，等明天来了再说。诗句用重复的词（今朝、明日、愁），读起来顺口好记，所以“今朝有酒今朝醉”成了今天还常说的俗语，不过现在多带一点批评，指只顾眼前、不考虑将来。读这首诗时要知道背后的心酸：表面潇洒，其实是一个怀才不遇的人在苦中作乐。
analysisEn: The title means “to console oneself” — to talk oneself out of one’s troubles. Luo Yin failed the imperial exam about ten times, and the poem reads like advice he is giving himself. Line one: when you win, sing out loud; when you lose, let it go. Line two: all the worry and resentment — let it drift away. Then come the famous lines: “If there’s wine today, get drunk today; if worries come tomorrow, worry tomorrow.” The repeated words (today, tomorrow, worry) give the lines a bouncy, easy rhythm, which is why 今朝有酒今朝醉 became a common saying. Today, though, people usually use it with a hint of criticism, for someone who lives only for the moment and doesn’t plan ahead. Reading the poem, remember the sadness underneath: the carefree tone is the brave face of a gifted man who never got his chance, finding what joy he can in hard times.
background: Luo Yin (833–909) is said to have failed the civil service exam around ten times over many years; he even changed his given name to Yin (“hidden”) in frustration. This short poem shows his mix of humour and bitterness.
pronunciation: 今朝 jīn zhāo（“朝”读 zhāo，早晨、今天；不读 cháo）。“得即高歌失即休”的“即”读 jí。
version: 采用通行版本，全诗四句。“多愁多恨亦悠悠”有版本作“多愁多恨亦休休”，网站用通行版。

lines.py: dé jí gāo gē shī jí xiū
lines.lit: Gaining, then sing aloud; losing, then stop;
lines.en: Win, and I sing out loud; lose, and I let it go.

lines.py: duō chóu duō hèn yì yōu yōu
lines.lit: much worry, much regret — also let it drift on.
lines.en: All my worries and regrets can drift away.

lines.py: jīn zhāo yǒu jiǔ jīn zhāo zuì
lines.lit: Today there is wine, today get drunk;
lines.en: If there’s wine today, I’ll be drunk today;

lines.py: míng rì chóu lái míng rì chóu
lines.en: if trouble comes tomorrow, tomorrow I’ll worry.

words.en: to console oneself; to drive away one’s own gloom
words.note: 遣：打发、排解，今天有“消遣”“排遣”。
现代汉语说“就”，书面语“即将”“立即”还用。

words.en: to stop; to let it be
words.note: 古义“停止、算了”；今天“休息”“休想”还有这个意思。

words.en: drifting, slow and long; (here) let it pass
words.note: 现代汉语仍用，如“岁月悠悠”。

words.en: drink today while there is wine — live for the moment
words.note: 今天是常用俗语，多含“只顾眼前”的批评意味。

imagery.name: 酒
imagery.zh: 酒是暂时忘掉失意和烦恼的办法，“今朝醉”背后是说不出的苦闷。
imagery.en: Wine is a way to forget failure for a while; “drunk today” hides a sorrow he doesn’t put into words.
